description: This Java class 'GetAttributeInfosRequest' is part of a testing or mocking framework for Zigbee devices, specifically handling requests to retrieve attribute information from a Zigbee device's cluster.

classes.name: GetAttributeInfosRequest
classes.description: A class representing a request to retrieve attribute information from a specific cluster on a Zigbee device. It extends DeviceRequest and executes a mocked Zigbee device request.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Executes the request on a given MockZigbeeDevice object by retrieving the relevant endpoint and cluster, then sending a response with attribute information.
